The existing image is ONLY the texture/palette reference, its low-angle geometry MUST change. Draw ONE gate on actual transparent RGBA background, entire roof and feet visible. Keep Liao/Jin anonymous medieval northern style: muted ochre-grey rammed-earth piers, grey brick edges, plain dark brown timber upper hall, grey tiled restrained hipped roof, small heavy wooden brackets, realistic matte fine-grained hand-painted game art. Upper-left illumination.
MAIN CHANGE: high-angle axonometric view with NO perspective. Ground frontage and depth axes must have equal and opposite screen slopes +0.5 and -0.5. Frontage descends 1 pixel for every 2 right; depth rises 1 for every 2 right. Camera yaw45 elevation30, verticals exactly upright. Show much more top roof area and much more side depth than the source. The footprint is a compact 8 wide by 4 deep rectangle, width/depth exactly TWO, not three. The two piers each measure 2 wide by4 deep, a centered open passage 4 wide by4 deep. Clear gap is exactly HALF the total front wall span; each pier is one quarter. Piers are rectangular and vertical, no battered flared bases.
On a square canvas place the three visible external ground corners approximately LEFT (180,790), FRONT (820,1110), RIGHT (1140,950): long facade vector (640,320), right side depth vector (320,-160). Hidden rear corner (500,630). Front pier inside feet (340,870) and (660,1030), opening between them. These are INVISIBLE construction points, never draw labels, lines, arrows or a diagram. Rebuild roof and timber hall consistently to this compact deep plan; roof must NOT extend into a long thin strip. Roof overhangs small. This is a broad deep tunnel gate, not a flat facade. Two feet on same ground plane, bottom masonry edges clean for measuring.
Keep clear passage truly transparent through and under the timber bridge, no door, floor, stairs, platform, ground patch or scenery. Short subtle lower-right contact shade only. At least8percent transparent margins. No people, faces, letters, signage, flags, plaques, labels, modern items, watermark, checkerboard or sheet. ONE sprite.
